questions.question: Haskell nima?
options: Sof funksional, statik tipli, lazily evaluated dasturlash tili

questions.question: Haskell da funksiya qanday e'lon qilinadi?
Haskell da tip signaturasi qanday yoziladi?
Haskell da immutability nima anglatadi?
options: Barcha qiymatlar o'zgarmas — bir marta belgilanib o'zgarmaydi

questions.question: Haskell da tuple nima?
options: Belgilangan sondagi, turli tipli elementlar — (1, 'a', True)

questions.question: Haskell da if-then-else nima?
options: Ifoda (expression) — natija har ikki branch da ham kerak

questions.question: Haskell da lazy evaluation nima?
options: Qiymat faqat kerak bo'lganda hisoblanadi — cheksiz listlar mumkin

questions.question: Haskell da data nima uchun?
options: Algebraic data type e'lon qilish — data Color = Red | Green | Blue

questions.question: Haskell da case nima uchun?
options: Pattern matching ifodasi — case x of ...

questions.question: Haskell da where nima uchun?
options: Funksiya ichida lokal ta'riflar — helper funksiyalar

questions.question: Haskell da let...in nima uchun?
options: Ifoda ichida lokal ta'riflar — let x = 5 in x + 1

questions.question: Haskell da Maybe nima?
options: Just a yoki Nothing — null ga xavfsiz alternativa

questions.question: Haskell da Either nima?
options: Left a yoki Right b — xato boshqarish uchun

questions.question: Haskell da typeclass nima?
options: Ad-hoc polymorphism interfeysi — Eq, Ord, Show, Functor

questions.question: Haskell da Functor nima?
options: fmap funksiyasi bilan ta'minlangan tip — f a dan f b ga transformatsiya

questions.question: Haskell da Monad nima?
options: >>= (bind) va return bilan ta'minlangan — IO, Maybe, List kabi

questions.question: Haskell da do notation nima?
options: Monadik bog'lash uchun sintatik shakar — IO dan chiqish imkoni

questions.question: Haskell da IO monad nima uchun?
options: Yon ta'sirlarni tip darajasida izolyatsiya qilish — sof funksional muhitda IO

questions.question: Haskell da type synonym nima?
options: type Name = String — mavjud tipga yangi nom

questions.question: Haskell da newtype nima?
options: Bitta maydonli wrapper — type dan farqli, zero runtime overhead

questions.question: Haskell da record syntax nima?
options: data Person = Person { name :: String, age :: Int } — nomlangan maydonlar

questions.question: Haskell da map funksiyasi nima?
options: Funksiyani list har elementiga qo'llash — map (* 2) [1,2,3]

questions.question: Haskell da fold nima uchun?
options: foldl va foldr — akkumulyator bilan listni bitta qiymatga aylantirish

questions.question: Haskell da function composition (.) nima?
options: (f . g) x = f (g x) — funksiyalar zanjiri

questions.question: Haskell da $ operatori nima uchun?
options: Qavslarni kamaytirish — f $ g x = f (g x), past prioritet function application

questions.question: Haskell da curry nima?
options: Ko'p argumentli funksiyani bir argumentli funksiyalar zanjiriga aylantirish — Haskell da default

questions.question: Haskell da Applicative nima?
options: <*> — wrapped funksiyani wrapped qiymatga qo'llash — Functor va Monad orasida

questions.question: Haskell da cabal va stack farqi?
options: cabal — eski build tool; stack — reproducible build, curated Stackage snapshot

questions.question: Haskell da GADTs nima?
options: Generalized Algebraic Data Types — konstruktor qaytarish tipini belgilash imkoni

questions.question: Haskell da type families nima?
options: Tip darajasidagi funksiyalar — associated type families, closed type families

questions.question: Haskell da STM (Software Transactional Memory) nima?
options: Atomik xotira operatsiyalari — concurrent code uchun lock-free alternativa

questions.question: Haskell da RankNTypes nima?
options: Yuqori darajali tip — forall bilan polimorfik funksiyalar argument sifatida

questions.question: Haskell da Template Haskell nima?
options: Kompilyatsiya vaqtida kod generatsiya — metaprogramming, macro

questions.question: Haskell da Lens library nima uchun?
Haskell da free monad nima?
options: Algebraic effects — interpreterdan ajratilgan DSL yaratish

questions.question: Haskell da contravariant functor nima?
options: fmap emas contramap — funksiya argumenti uchun mapping

questions.question: Haskell da concatMap nima?
options: map va concat birlashtirilgan — monomorphic bind, >>= listlar uchun

questions.question: Haskell da seq va deepseq farqi?
options: seq — WHNF ga to'liq hisoblash; deepseq — to'liq (deep) hisoblash

questions.question: Haskell da profunctor nima?
options: Covariant va contravariant bo'lgan bifunctor — Arrow, Star kabi

questions.question: Haskell da Data.Map.Strict va Data.Map.Lazy farqi?
options: Strict — qiymatlar darhol baholanadi (memory), Lazy — thunk saqlanadi

questions.question: Haskell da Yesod web framework nima?
options: Type-safe, high performance Haskell web framework — compile-time routing

questions.question: Haskell da Aeson nima?
options: JSON encode/decode kutubxona — FromJSON, ToJSON instance

questions.question: Haskell da Servant nima?
options: Tip darajasida API ta'riflash va server/client kod generatsiya frameworki
